title: Requesting the check-in list
passage:
Could you email me yesterday’s check-in list?
A. I’ll send it as soon as I’m back at my desk.
B. I preferred yesterday’s session.
C. The sign-in station is by the lift.
passageZh:
能用電子郵件把昨天的報到名單寄給我嗎？
A. 我一回辦公桌就寄給你。
B. 我比較喜歡昨天那場。
C. 報到處在電梯旁。
